fusions.name: Upheaval
fusions.desc: Your roots heave the ground 4 tiles ahead of you, which deals 12 rock damage to everything standing on it and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Splitting Wedge
fusions.desc: Drives a root into the target and splits it open: the blow deals 30 rock damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Silica Sheath
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchored in Bedrock
fusions.desc: Your rock attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
